subject: Embedding unit economics, dimension tiers & model compatibility — SignalEdge evaluation
messages:
From: Anna Li <anna@signaledge.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 09:02:00 +0000
Subject: Embeddings rate card + dimension pricing questions

Hi Priyom,

We’re kicking off a short evaluation of embedding providers and I was hoping to get Redwood’s baseline rate card for embeddings (per-vector or per-token — whichever you publish), plus a quick note on how you price by vector dimension. Two specific asks:

- What models do you currently support for embeddings (Redwood-branded and any compatible open models)?
- Do you have tiered pricing by dimension (e.g., 128/256/768/1536)? If so, what are the baseline prices and the minimum volume for discounts?
- We’ll likely send ~40M–60M vectors/month initially, with spikes up to ~5k QPS for short periods — any guidance on commitments vs on-demand cost?

Also attaching the RFP sections around security and expected usage. Can you route to pricing/Product if needed?

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Li
Head of Data Platforms
SignalEdge
attachments: SE_RFP_Security.pdf (pdf), sample-usage.csv (csv)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Li <anna@signaledge.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 13:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Embeddings rate card + dimension pricing questions

Hi Anna — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the RFP snippet and the sample usage (received). I’ve pulled a concise baseline here to help you model economics quickly; below are our common options and a few clarifying questions so we can pull together a committed proposal: 

Baseline (hosted API, public pricing band):
- Per-vector (up to 128 dims): $0.00010 / vector
- Per-vector (129–512 dims): $0.00014 / vector
- Per-vector (513–1024 dims): $0.00030 / vector
- Per-vector (1025–2048 dims): $0.00055 / vector
- If you prefer per-token equivalent (for text->embed flows) we map tokens->vectors after model truncation; let me know if you want that calc.

Model compatibility (short):
- Redwood-embed-1-small (128d), Redwood-embed-2 (512d), Redwood-embed-3-large (1536d) — all in hosted catalog.
- We also support embedding export/compat for common open checkpoints we verify; there can be minor differences in dimension and normalization across forks.

Commit guidance: for 40–60M vectors/month we typically recommend a 6–12 month commitment to unlock a 10–25% discount depending on exclusivity and prepay. Spiky QPS is handled by burst capacity on Dedicated or through autoscaling buffers on hosted with predictable egress throttles.

Quick clarifying Qs:
1) What fraction of the vectors are 1536d vs 512d vs small? (pricing impact is >2x across tiers)
2) Do you need us to store vectors (we can include object store egress/storage charges) or is this strictly generation and export to your indexer?

I’m looping in Lauren (sales engineer) and Karthik (product) to add technical/commercial details. I’ll follow up with a short proposal if you can share the 7-day sample of typical records.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri_yom@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 13:18:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Embeddings rate card + dimension pricing questions — SignalEdge (internal)

Lauren / Karthik — forwarding SignalEdge’s ask. Key points: ~40–60M vectors/mo with short spikes to ~5k QPS; they want per-dimension clarity and committed discount options for 6–12 months.

My thoughts (internal):
- Recommend offering a mid-band commercial: 15% off baseline for 6mo commit at 50M vectors/mo, 22% off for 12mo prepay. Acceptable to include a 30-day opt-out for first month trial credit.
- Technical: provide explicit model mapping and a small sample normalization note: our Redwood-embed-3-large uses L2-normalized outputs; many open forks may differ and small cosine recalibration could be required.
- Add an optional managed-index offering (we can recommend Redwood Optimize settings for batching/kv caching) but leave indexing costs to SignalEdge unless they want us to host vectors.

Can you confirm the percent of 1536d usage and whether they want storage? I’ll draft a one-page commercial once you confirm.

— Priyom

From: Anna Li <anna@signaledge.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@signaledge.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 15:44:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Embeddings rate card + dimension pricing questions

Thanks, Priyom — this is helpful. A few data points to help you size the ask: 

- Monthly volume: ~45M vectors/month initially.
- Dimension mix: ~60% at 512d (semantic search), ~35% at 1536d (ranking + rerank), ~5% at 128d (metadata).
- Storage: we will store vectors in our vector DB (not asking Redwood to host). We do want to understand egress/transfer caps for export and an SLA on generation latency (95th percentile target <120ms).
- Procurement: we try to consolidate on 12-month prepay deals where possible; procurement will ask for the detailed price ladder and a DocuSign-ready SOW.

Can you send a short proposal with a 6- and 12-month commitment option and the specific per-dimension prices applied to our mix? Procurement is procurement@signaledge.com — please include them on the proposal.

Best,
Anna

Subject: Commercial proposal: SignalEdge embedding tiers & commitment options

Anna / procurement team — thanks for the quick details. Attached is a short commercial and next steps. Key items summarized below (this note is the authoritative commercial summary pending DocuSign SOW):

Assumptions (from your note): 45M vectors/month; dim mix: 60% 512d / 35% 1536d / 5% 128d; vectors stored in SignalEdge DB.

Proposed pricing (hosted API per-vector / billed monthly):
- 128d: $0.00009 / vector
- 512d: $0.00012 / vector
- 1536d: $0.00028 / vector
- Monthly price = sum(dim_tier_price * vectors_in_tier)

Commit discounts (applied to baseline above):
- 6-month commitment (50M committed MV): 15% off baseline monthly pricing; overage billed at baseline rate.
- 12-month prepay (annual invoice upfront): 22% off baseline; includes one month free if prepaid annually.

Operational SLA / notes:
- 95th percentile generation latency target: <120ms for embed generation in our hosted region (us-west).
- Export/egress: first 100GB/month free; additional outbound billed at $0.01/GB.
- Model compatibility: Proposal pins to Redwood-embed-2 (512d) and Redwood-embed-3-large (1536d). If you want to use an external checkpoint, we will run a compatibility verification; minor normalization adjustment may be required.

Trial / onboarding credit:
- We’ll provide $20k in trial credits for the first 30 days to validate quality and throughput. Trial credit applies only to inference (not storage).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm acceptance of the pricing bands and commitment preference (6mo vs 12mo).
2) Share the procurement contact for DocuSign; I’ve CC’d them above.
3) If you want a short technical workshop, Lauren can run a 60–90 minute session to align embedding norms and batching settings.

I’ve attached a one-page PDF (SignalEdge-Proposal-Redwood-20280713.pdf) and a DocuSign link to the Statement of Work: https://docusign.com/SE-Redwood-SOW-4309 (draft).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Priyom Das
